subject: Animation
title: The National Film Board of Canada
description: Learn The National Film Board of Canada in one minute.

hook.text: Canada's National Film Board has won more Oscar nominations for animation than any other single organization.

buildup.text: The NFB funds experimental animation that no commercial studio would finance, pushing the art form forward.

discovery.text: Norman McLaren, the NFB's greatest artist, painted directly on film strips to create animation without a camera.

twist.text: Despite its award record, most Canadians have never seen an NFB animated film in a theater.

climax.text: The NFB proves that public funding for experimental animation produces globally significant art.

punchline.text: Canada's most awarded art institution is its least watched.

quiz.question: Why is Canada's National Film Board significant in animation history?
options: It produces all Canadian television shows
It has won more Oscar nominations for animation than any other organization by funding experimental work
It is the world's largest commercial animation studio
